# Marky v1.9.1

Fixes for the Quiet Desk redesign.

### Fixes

- **No more white scrollbar on macOS.** The sidebar and preview no longer show the wide white native scrollbar. Scrollbars stay hidden until you scroll, as intended.
- **OPEN list no longer squeezes the file tree.** With many open files, the OPEN section now takes at most about a third of the sidebar and scrolls on its own. It can also be collapsed, and its header shows how many files are open.
- **Tab outlines no longer cut off.** The active tab's outline is drawn in full when it sits at either end of the tab strip.
